decisive_items: Coronary computed tomography angiography showed no abnormalities
Patient developed left bundle-branch block (LBBB) in stage 2 at heart rate of 107 beats per minute with chest pain
LBBB resolved following exercise cessation with immediate angina relief
response.rationale: Exercise-induced LBBB with angina and normal coronary imaging best fits Cardiac Syndrome X (microvascular disease). Vasospastic angina typically occurs at rest, and CAD is excluded by normal CTA.

rejected.why: No hypertrophy or obstructive features; normal CTA and exertional LBBB pattern not specific to HCM.
Vasospastic angina usually at rest, not consistently exertional; LBBB with exercise is atypical.
MVP lacks supporting auscultatory/echo findings and does not explain LBBB.
No murmur or valvular evidence; exercise LBBB with normal CTA not suggestive of AS.
Normal CTA directly contradicts epicardial coronary artery disease.
